title: Heart in the Sky at NASA Kennedy
originalTitle: Heart in the Sky at NASA Kennedy
content:
HQ Web Team

Nov 12, 2026

The U.S. Air Force Thunderbirds create a heart-shaped smoke trail during a flight maneuver near NASA’s Vehicle Assembly Building during the agency’s MAX POWER expo and air show on Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026, at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

NASA’s MAX POWER is an aerospace festival celebrating the past, present, and future of flight and space exploration in honor of America’s 250th anniversary.
